title: Artificial Intelligence in Veterinary Medicine: Transforming Animal Healthcare Through Innovation
description: Artificial intelligence transforms veterinary care with diagnostic tools, predictive health monitoring, and personalized treatments.
short_description: A grounded look at AI in Veterinary Medicine, covering what works, what wobbles, and what matters in practice.
author: Jonathan Harris
audience: A clear, no-hype briefing on AI in Veterinary Medicine for clinicians, healthcare managers, founders, analysts, and readers tracking care delivery.
